def predict2(g, neigh_comp=4, neigh_bound=8, edge_outside=True):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    start=next((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==6)
    dirs4=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
    dirs8=[(dr,dc) for dr in [-1,0,1] for dc in [-1,0,1] if (dr,dc)!=(0,0)]
    dirs=dirs4 if neigh_comp==4 else dirs8
    seen=set(); q=deque([start]);
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        if (r,c) in seen or not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): continue
        if g[r][c] not in (8,6): continue
        seen.add((r,c))
        for dr,dc in dirs: q.append((r+dr,c+dc))
    bdirs=dirs8 if neigh_bound==8 else dirs4
    for r,c in seen:
        if g[r][c]!=8: continue
        b=False
        for dr,dc in bdirs:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W):
                if edge_outside: b=True
            elif g[rr][cc]==1: b=True
        if b:out[r][c]=7
    return out
